info.title: SHAPI advisory stripe-endive-setup-intent-payment-method-types-removed
info.summary: Stripe 2026-09-30.endive removes payment_method_types from Setup Intent create and update

workflows.summary: Shows the change: From API version 2026-09-30.endive, payment_method_types is no longer writable on Setup Intents: create and update requests that send it return a 400 error. It stays a read-only property on the Setup Intent.

steps.description: POST /v1/setup_intents succeeds, with the changed response the advisory describes (required-field)
POST /v1/setup_intents/{intent} succeeds, with the changed response the advisory describes (required-field)
POST /v1/setup_intents/{intent}/cancel succeeds, with the changed response the advisory describes (required-field)
POST /v1/setup_intents/{intent}/confirm succeeds, with the changed response the advisory describes (required-field)
POST /v1/setup_intents/{intent}/verify_microdeposits succeeds, with the changed response the advisory describes (required-field)
